about: Named events for `listen replay … timeline/summary`. Each rule: name, on (event kinds: chat, title, bossbar), match (Python regex on the color-stripped text, multi-line chat messages searched as a whole; for bossbar the bar name, ops add/name only). First matching rule wins (specific before generic); unknown lines stay raw. Sources: docs/research/m7-capture-2026-11-08.md (M7 lines), docs/research/dev-bridge-first-real-run-2026-11-11.md (9 M4 party-finder runs, Croesus). Edit freely; never treat this as a closed set.

rules.name: class bonus
rules.match: ^Your \w+ stats are doubled because you are the only player using this class!

rules.name: run start
rules.match: ^\[NPC\] Mort: Here, I found this map

rules.name: blood open
rules.match: The BLOOD DOOR has been opened!

rules.name: blood start
rules.match: ^\[BOSS\] The Watcher: Ah, we meet again

rules.name: blood done
rules.match: ^\[BOSS\] The Watcher: You have proven yourself

rules.name: boss defeated F4 Thorn
rules.match: ^\[BOSS\] Thorn: This is it\.\.\. where shall I go now\?

rules.name: P4 Necron
rules.match: ^\[BOSS\] Necron: You went further than any human

rules.name: giga lightning
rules.match: ^\[BOSS\] Storm: (THUNDER LET ME BE YOUR CATALYST!|ENERGY HEED MY CALL!)

rules.name: storm dead

rules.name: quiz answer
rules.match: ^\[STATUE\] Oruo the Omniscient: \w{1,16} answered (Question #\d+|the final question) correctly!

rules.name: wither essence found

rules.name: save proc

rules.name: teammate left
rules.match: ^\w{1,16} has disconnected, they have \d+ minutes to rejoin

rules.name: rng meter set

rules.name: metal detector find
rules.match: You found .* with your Metal Detector!
